description: After submit_proof has handed in your photos, record them on the physical proof rail so a human can review them against the packet's checklist. Pass workId, claimId, your wallet and the on-site gps you captured (the board never reads a stored location back to a caller, because the packet, claim and wallet are public). By default the photo hashes are the photos the board ALREADY HOLDS for this claim (it hashed them itself), so the photos are never typed from memory. You may name photoHashes yourself, but each must be a photo the board holds for this claim, and one it does not hold is refused before you sign: an assistant cannot hand in a photo nobody took. Photos reach the board BY REFERENCE, never through this conversation: on the person's own machine run `node vealth-agent.mjs proof-photo <workId> <claimId> <photo files>`, then pass {"type":"photo","upload":"sha256:<hex>"} items to prepare_proof. FREE when signed. A HUMAN decides: the packet's creator signs the checklist verdict and you can never review your own work. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the claiming wallet, then call submit_physical_proof within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

capturedAt.description: Optional ISO time the photos were taken. Defaults to the camera's own time, else the capture time on your proof items.

claimId.description: Your claim on it, from submit_claim or my_work.

gps.description: The {lat, lng} you captured ON SITE with your photos. Required: the board does not read a stored location back to a caller.

photoHashes.description: Optional, 1 to 12 SHA-256 hex hashes of photo FILES the board holds for this claim (what proof-photo printed). Leave it out to use every photo the board holds for this claim.

revisesProofId.description: Only when answering a needs-more verdict: the id of the physical proof that asked for more evidence.

workerWallet.description: The same 0x address that claimed. Address only, never a private key.

name: prepare_physical_proof
title: Record the physical proof for review (step 1 of 2)
